attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a56c2
attributes.field_text: あふくまに / きりたちくもり / 明ぬとも / 君をはやらし / まてはすへなし
attributes.field_text_romaji: Abukuma ni / kiri tachikumori / akenu tomo / kimi oba yaraji / mateba sube nashi
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Abukuma ni / kiri tachikumori / akenu tomo / kimi oba yaraji / mateba sube nashi
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'the mists spread over/ the Abukuma \tbut though/ dawn has come \tI will/ not send him away \tfor to/ have to wait is too painful', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel R. and Henkenius, Mary C. (1984): p.371'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a56c3
attributes.field_text: よとともに / あふくま川の / 遠けれは / そこなるかけを / みぬそわひしき
attributes.field_text_romaji: yo to tomoni / Abukumagawa no / tōkereba / soko naru kage o / minu zo wabishiki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: yo to tomoni / Abukumagawa no / tōkereba / soko naru kage o / minu zo wabishiki
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'As long as the world lasts/ The Abukuma River/ Is very far,/ So your image in the deeps/  Not seeing it, I suffer.', 'source': 'Kern, J. Christopher'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a56c4
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 女のさうしによるよる立よりつつ、物なといひてのち
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 女のさうしによるよる立よりつつ、物なといひてのち
attributes.field_text: あふくまの / きりとはなしに / 夜もすから / 立わたりつつ / よをもふるかな
attributes.field_text_romaji: Abukuma no / kiri to wa nashi ni / yomosugara  / tachiwataritsutsu  / yo o mo furu kana
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: Abukuma no / kiri to wa nashi ni / yomosugara  / tachiwataritsutsu  / yo o mo furu kana
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'I am not the mist of Abukuma/  but all through the night/  I stand and cross/  passing the time!', 'source': 'Kern, J. Christopher'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a56c5
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 為仲朝臣陸奥守にて侍りける時、延任しつとききてつかはしける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 為仲朝臣陸奥守にて侍りける時、延任しつとききてつかはしける
attributes.field_text: まつ我は / 哀八十年に / 成ぬるを / あふくま川の / 遠さかりぬる
attributes.field_text_romaji: matsu ware wa / aware yasoji ni / narinuru o / Abukumagawa no / tōzakari tsutsu
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: matsu ware wa / aware yasoji ni / narinuru o / Abukumagawa no / tōzakari tsutsu

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a56c6
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 一条院、上東門院に行幸せさせ給ひけるに
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 一条院、上東門院に行幸せさせ給ひけるに
attributes.field_text: 君か代に / あふくま川の / そこ清み / 千年をへつつ / すまむとそ思
attributes.field_text_romaji: kimi ga yo ni / Abukumagawa no / soko kiyomi / chitose o hetsutsu / sumamu to zo omou
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kimi ga yo ni / Abukumagawa no / soko kiyomi / chitose o hetsutsu / sumamu to zo omou

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a56c7
attributes.field_kotobagaki: みちのくにのすけにてまかりける時、範永朝臣のもとにつかはしける
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: みちのくにのすけにてまかりける時、範永朝臣のもとにつかはしける
attributes.field_text: 行末に / あふくま川の / なかりせは / いかにかせまし / けふの別を
attributes.field_text_romaji: yukusue ni / Abukumagawa no / nakari seba / ikani ka semashi / kyō no wakare o
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: yukusue ni / Abukumagawa no / nakari seba / ikani ka semashi / kyō no wakare o
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'at your journey’s end/ Abukuma River \tif/ there were no hope of/ our meeting again \twhat would/ we feel at today’s parting', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.357-358'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a56c8
attributes.field_text: 君に又 / あふくま川を / 待へきに / のこりすくなき / 我そ悲しき
attributes.field_text_romaji: kimi ni mata / Abukumagawa o / matsubeki ni / nokori sukunaki / ware zo kanashiki
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kimi ni mata / Abukumagawa o / matsubeki ni / nokori sukunaki / ware zo kanashiki
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'I know you await/ our hoped-for meeting \tRiver/ of Abukuma/ yet I’m saddened by the thought/ of the few years left to me', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.358'}]

attributes.title: 5c51d01b0eb1485b546a56c9
attributes.field_kotobagaki: 最勝四天王院のしやうしに、あふくま川かきたるところ
attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 最勝四天王院のしやうしに、あふくま川かきたるところ
attributes.field_text: 君か代に / あふくま川の / 埋木も / 氷のしたに / 春をまちけり
attributes.field_text_romaji: kimi ga yo ni / Abukumagawa no / mumoregi mo / kōri no shita ni / haru o machikeri
attributes.field_text_romaji_long: kimi ga yo ni / Abukumagawa no / mumoregi mo / kōri no shita ni / haru o machikeri
attributes.field_translations: [{'text': 'living in the reign/ of my lord \teven submerged/ logs beneath the ice/ of Abukuma River/ anticipate the spring thaw', 'source': 'Rodd, Laurel Rasplica (2015): p.646'}]

attributes.title: 60aa294cff67c34b74956639
attributes.field_text: とかくして越行ままに、あふくま川を渡る。左に会津根高く、右に岩城・相馬・三春の庄、常陸・下野の地をさかひて山つらなる。かけ沼と云所を行に、今日は空曇て物影うつらす。

attributes.field_kotobagaki_long: 久安百首歌奉りける、なかうた
